# Logan Eberwein

Public profile: https://loganeberwein.github.io/

Sophomore at the School of Science and Engineering (Yvonne A. Ewell Townview Center), Dallas, Texas, class of 2029. Founder of WellLens. Independent researcher working on the Riemann Hypothesis with AI tools.

## Apps

- WellLens (September 2025 to present): fitness app that builds a workout plan from onboarding answers, with a gym buddy feature where friends send each other daily proof of their workouts. In beta on TestFlight; release planned within weeks.
- Checkback: Family Tasks: kids send photo proof of finished tasks and earn points toward rewards their parents choose. Release planned within days.

Logan directs the AI tools that write the code; he handles product decisions, design and testing.

## Research (August 2025 to present)

AI-assisted work on the Riemann Hypothesis: 190 documented approaches, 297 operator candidates, Lean 4 formalization, Python computations and a public corrections log. Neither paper is a proof of RH.

- Riemann Hypothesis Research Program: Complete Progress Report and Formal Ledger (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23174797
- The Truncated Weil Quadratic Form: Inertia, Visibility, Structural Measurements, and No-Go Theorems for the Riemann Hypothesis (2026). https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23177438
